pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on adding to positions within 5 pips of an existing entry; pyramid only on confirmed structural breakouts with positive open trade equity.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory ATR-based volatility filter: block entries when 1-minute ATR exceeds 3x the 20-period moving average to avoid high-impact noise wicks.
profit_harvest_threshold: Trigger aggressive trailing stops or partial profit-taking as soon as floating profit hits +$15.00 to guarantee asymmetric win-to-loss ratios ($15-$30+ wins vs $4-$6 max losses).
